sloka: एतस्य मृग रत्नस्य परार्ध्ये कांचन त्वचि ।उपवेक्ष्यति वैदेही मया सह सुमध्यमा ॥३-४३-३५॥
transliteration: etasya mṛga ratnasya parārdhye kāṁcana tvaci ।upavekṣyati vaidehī mayā saha sumadhyamā ॥3-43-35॥

translations.english: The skins of various types of deer like Priyaki, Kadali or goats or sheep cannot be compared in softness to the skin of this deer.
